title: German Pancake
description: A delicious and easy German pancake recipe perfect for celebrating Saturday or serving to guests.
steps: Place the butter sections into a 9x13-inch baking dish and put it in the oven to melt.
In a mixing bowl, combine the eggs, flour, milk, vanilla extract, and salt. Mix until well combined.
Once the butter is melted and the oven is preheated, pour the egg mixture into the baking dish over the melted butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for approximately 20 minutes, or until the pancake is puffed and golden.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately with maple syrup on top.
notes:
Serve immediately with maple syrup for best results.
